resources.string: Show, hide, reorder and pin the toolbar buttons (including voice input)

Switch: show the button. Arrows: order, left to right. Pin: keep it at the right, left of the hide-keyboard button, visible even with the toolbar collapsed; unpinned buttons only show when the toolbar is expanded.
Voice input (tap to talk, tap again to recognize; not in password fields)
In landscape the keyboard floats over the app: drag the bar at its bottom to move it, drag a bottom corner to resize it. The toolbar button toggles it too.
Download the latest release of this fork from GitHub and install it
